gameLoop: Run and jump across floating cliff segments: clear pits, stomp moss crawlers or dodge them, hop spike strips, grab coins, tag checkpoints, and reach the stone arch exit.

obstacles.role: patrolling crawler; stomp it or jump over
patrolling crawler; stomp it or jump over

collectibles: Coin arcs over each pit plus coin triplets on the floating timber platforms, 10 points each.
progression: Single hand-tuned level (3200px): three pits, three crawlers, three spike strips, two checkpoints, one exit arch.
scoring: 10 points per coin, 25 per stomp, plus up to 5 points per second under the 60s par time; best score persists locally.
loseCondition: Lose all 3 health to enemies, spikes, or pit falls.
notes: Demo blueprint for the side-scroller template.
